## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

### Scope
- [ ] This PR has a clearly defined purpose.
- [ ] Changes are limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Unrelated files were not modified.

### Reproducibility
- [ ] Reproducibility implications have been considered.
- [ ] Training configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] Evaluation changes are documented.
- [ ] Dataset changes include provenance information.

### Dataset Integrity
*If applicable:*
- [ ] Dataset provenance is documented.
- [ ] Licensing has been considered.
- [ ] No known benchmark contamination was introduced.
- [ ] Evaluation holdout separation remains intact.

### Research Integrity
- [ ] Claims are supported by evidence.
- [ ] Experimental results are clearly distinguished from hypotheses.
- [ ] Evaluation methodology is documented.
- [ ] No unsupported performance claims are introduced.

### Security
- [ ] No credentials or secrets were committed.
- [ ] No sensitive/private data was committed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes are appropriately disclosed.

### Documentation
- [ ] Relevant documentation was updated.
- [ ] Citation/provenance requirements were preserved.

### Review
- [ ] I have reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] I have not intentionally modified protected research artifacts.
